headline: Incineram fire worker
title: Incineram | Fire Claw Fighter And Base Worker | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need a fire worker for your Palworld one point zero base? Incineram spawns around the volcanic areas at about level thirty to forty. Its partner skill, Flameclaw Hunter, sends it at your target with Hellfire Claw, boosting that attack up to two point five times. At base it works Kindling level three and Mining level three. Is Incineram on your team? Comment below!
description: Incineram in Palworld 1.0 is a volcanic Fire Pal that works Kindling and Mining at level three and attacks with Hellfire Claw.
